# Ethos Subprocessor List

Last Updated: 9 July 2026

This page lists the Subprocessors engaged by Ethos to provide processing of Customer Data, as defined in the Ethos Data Processing Agreement available at [askethos.com/ethos-dpa](https://agent.askethos.com/ethos-dpa). This list is regularly updated to reflect current information about our Subprocessors. Please regularly check this page for updates.

If you have any questions regarding our Subprocessors or privacy practices, please reach out to [support@askethos.com](mailto:support@askethos.com).

| Subprocessor Name | Purpose | Location |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Amazon Web Services (AWS) | Cloud infrastructure and hosting | Worldwide |
| Anthropic | Artificial intelligence and language processing services | Worldwide |
| Apollo | B2B sales intelligence and lead generation | Worldwide |
| Auth0 (Okta) | Identity, authentication and user management | Worldwide |
| Bright Data | Web data collection infrastructure | Worldwide |
| Cartesia | Text-to-speech services for the voice agent | Worldwide |
| Composio | Managed third-party integrations (e.g., Gmail, calendar) | Worldwide |
| Daily.co | Real-time audio and video room infrastructure | Worldwide |
| Datadog | Application performance monitoring, logging and observability | Worldwide |
| Deepgram | Speech-to-text services for the voice agent | Worldwide |
| ElevenLabs | Speech-to-text and text-to-speech services for the voice agent | Worldwide |
| EnrichLayer | Professional profile data enrichment | Worldwide |
| Firecrawl | Web scraping and content extraction | Worldwide |
| Google | Artificial intelligence and language processing services (Gemini), and email services (Gmail API) | Worldwide |
| Groq | Artificial intelligence and inference services | Worldwide |
| Hunter | Email verification and discovery | Worldwide |
| LangSmith (LangChain) | LLM tracing, evaluation and observability | Worldwide |
| LiveKit | Real-time voice and video infrastructure for the voice agent | Worldwide |
| OpenAI | Artificial intelligence and language processing services | Worldwide |
| OpenRouter | Artificial intelligence model gateway and routing | Worldwide |
| Pipecat Cloud | Voice agent hosting and orchestration | Worldwide |
| PostHog | Product analytics, feature flags and session replay | Worldwide |
| Postmark | Transactional email delivery services | Worldwide |
| Respondent.io | Research participant scheduling and management | Worldwide |
| RevenueBase | B2B sales intelligence and lead generation | Worldwide |
| Revolut | Payout processing for Experts | Worldwide |
| Stripe | Payment processing and billing | Worldwide |
| Twilio | SMS and WhatsApp messaging services | Worldwide |
| Zerobounce | Email validation and verification services | Worldwide |
